concerns.location: tasks.md:User Story 1 (US1) – CPU‑Feasible Model Training and Baseline Comparison
concerns.text: US 1 tasks (T001, T002, T004, T005, T006, T007, T013) depend on the scaffold‑based split produced by T003, which belongs to US 3. This creates a cross‑story dependency, violating the rule that *tasks within a User Story must form an independently‑shippable unit* (i.e., the story should be testable end‑to‑end without requiring artifacts from another story). Re‑order or refactor the tasks so that US 1 either includes the split step or the split is moved into a shared foundational phase that precedes all stories.
